database_annotations.value: Energy-transfer acceptor. Its role is to transduce the blue chemiluminescence of the protein aequorin into green fluorescent light by energy transfer. Fluoresces in vivo upon receiving energy from the Ca(2+)-activated photoprotein aequorin

model_predictions.description: Short, glycine/alanine-rich hydrophobic alpha-helices that insert into or span membranes—including single-pass transmembrane anchors, fusion peptides, and pore/translocation helices—frequently containing GxxxG/glycine‑zipper motifs used for helix packing.
